meta.title: build: add parallel and concurrency flags to test:ci and build:ci
meta.body_summary: Add --concurrency=100% flag to package.json test:ci and build:ci scripts to improve build performance via parallel execution.

perf_labels.notes: Devin tried adding --concurrency=100% to package.json scripts but found no build performance improvement, so closed the PR.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 20 changed lines in a single file, this is a tiny build configuration change by absolute volume. As a small-step build performance PR it was closed—not merged—because the agent itself observed no performance gain.

review_details.concern_detail: Devin agent closed the PR with comment 'Closing this PR as it did not improve build performance.' No human review feedback was given; the agent itself judged the performance improvement insufficient.
review_details.performance_claim: Adding --concurrency=100% flag to test:ci and build:ci scripts improves build performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: Agent self-closed after concluding no performance improvement; no external CHANGES_REQUESTED.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple build configuration change required empirical performance testing to validate the claim; agent could add flags but could not verify improvement and self-terminated the PR.
